Backend 11/11 pytest pass: register-organization sets welcome_demo='pending' + admin_org role, /api/demo/welcome returns prefill (nome/cognome/email/telefono/organizzazione) + duration_min=30, /api/demo/slots returns slots per SA config (Mon-Fri 10-12, min_notice 12h), POST /api/demo/welcome/book persists lead with demo_status='confermata' + simulated Meet link (meet.google.com/sim-...) + flips welcome_demo to 'booked', booked slot disappears from both /api/demo/slots AND /api/video-support/slots (anti-overlap verified), double-book of same slot by a second new org -> 409, /api/demo/welcome/dismiss sets welcome_demo='dismissed' (idempotent on re-call), SA GET/PUT /api/platform/demo/config roundtrip, PUT 400 on invalid window (start>=end), non-SA 403 on both GET/PUT, SA request on /api/demo/welcome rejected (no org). Nessuna carta di credito richiesta.'; CTAs 'Registrati gratis' on all expected places (landing-try-cta, hero-cta-start-free, demo-try-cta/bottom/floating, pricing-header-cta, plan-cta-bronze/silver/gold anonymous); no lead-form on home. Flow A: new org registers → login → welcome-demo-dialog opens → book → demo-calendar (15 enabled days) → pick time (4 times/day) → form prefilled (nome, email disabled, org, tel) → confirm → welcome-demo-done shown with Meet simulated link → reload: dialog does NOT reopen, book-demo-menu-link hidden. Flow B: welcome-demo-skip → reload: dialog not reopened, trial-chip shows 'Prova GOLD · Ti restano 14 giorni', profile menu shows book-demo-menu-link which reopens dialog directly in calendar view. Mobile 390: dialog fits viewport (390×... bbox), calendar not cut. Note: onboarding-welcome tutorial correctly appears only after dismissal/booking (not during pending). CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: /app/frontend/src/components/Onboarding.jsx::TutorialLauncher used user?.welcome_demo in a useEffect (lines 142+145) but did not destructure `user` from useAuth — ReferenceError 'user is not defined' broke the entire /app layout immediately after login for every eligible user (anyone with welcome_demo in [pending, dismissed]). Fix: added `const { user } = useAuth();` at the top of TutorialLauncher.

demo_slots.py:116-148 book() — correct flow: slot availability check → unique-index insert on demo_slot_locks (DuplicateKey→409) → meet creation → persist lead + flip welcome_demo. If meet creation fails the lock is deleted (good: no orphan lock). Note: if sync_lead/meet_for_demo transiently fails *after* the lock insert the function raises 502; the lock is removed. Good.

demo_slots.py:79 slots() computes 'taken' from demo_slot_locks ∪ video_support_bookings.slot_lock, so anti-overlap is bidirectional (confirmed in test). However, slot_lock may be null for some older video_support_bookings; the $type:string filter handles that correctly.

After skip (state becomes 'dismissed') close() also skips dismiss (correct).

For invited collaborators (org_role != 'admin_org') the backend eligibility is NOT re-checked in Layout — but welcome_demo is only populated for admin_org users (server.py:673), so collaborators get welcome_demo=null and the link is correctly hidden. rca of the issue: RCA: In /app/frontend/src/components/Onboarding.jsx the TutorialLauncher component (line 126) uses `user?.welcome_demo` inside a useEffect (lines 142, 145) but did not destructure `user` from useAuth() — only `info, patch, isSuper` were destructured from useTutorial(). The webpack/babel optional-chaining transform produced `(_user2 = user) === null || _user2 === void 0 ? void 0 : _user2.welcome_demo` which throws ReferenceError 'user is not defined' as soon as the component mounts. Because TutorialLauncher is rendered inside the main app Layout for all authenticated users, the entire /app route crashed immediately after login for anyone with welcome_demo in {pending, dismissed, booked}. Fix applied: added `const { user } = useAuth();` as the first line of TutorialLauncher. The import `useAuth` was already present (line 4). Reproduction: register a new org via /registrati or POST /api/auth/register-organization, then log in — before the fix the Runtime Error dialog appears and WelcomeDemo never gets a chance to open; after the fix the welcome-demo-dialog shows correctly and the full flow (book/skip + Meet link + state persistence + anti-overlap with video-support) works end-to-end.
